description: A filed.fyi lorelog record: the shared filed prelude (closed boris frontmatter, `relations` carried), the `# title` heading, a verbatim narrative lede, then the generated residue — Related Aphorisms, Related Haikus, Related Limericks — and the upgrade apparatus (Field Testimony quotes with footnotes, a Field Notes palette, the Provenance Ledger, Annotations). Record-specific mid-sections ride in `extra_sections`. Canon bodies are verbatim extracted strings; section headings belong to the template.

title.role: record title; frontmatter `title` and the `#` heading when title_heading is set

title_heading.role: non-empty when the record carries its own `# <title>` heading; extraction sets it

lede.role: the verbatim narrative between the title heading and the first section

testimony.role: ## Field Testimony: one blockquote each; `note` may key a `notes` footnote

note.role: key into `notes`; renders a [^key] ref after the quote

field_notes.role: ## Field Notes: one block each, of the kind the server chose (callout, quote, list)

kind.role: block kind; the server picks it, copy it as given

text.role: callout kind: the note body, one short paragraph

line.role: quote kind: one verbatim line from a source, rendered as a blockquote

ledger.role: ## Provenance Ledger rows; the header (entry | detail) is fixed in the template

notes.role: footnotes: key -> note text, rendered as [^key]: defs under 'Annotations'. Every key must be referenced by some testimony `note`; the server picks the key and anchor, write the note text only, copied verbatim from a source

extra_sections.role: non-canon sections captured verbatim: {after: slot name or 'preamble', heading: text, level: 1|2, body: verbatim}. Extraction fills this; the ratchet never grows it
